scope: Finite product-vector tests for J=(1-epsilon)I-(F+Omega_un)/(d+1). This is an attributed orthogonally covariant map family. Indefinite Choi operators are not density matrices. Neither all-copy positivity nor physical N0 is proved.

controls.why_admissible: The single-site Choi is block positive for epsilon<=1/3, and the tensor output is explicitly indefinite.
